title: NexBridge Careers - Backend Platform Engineer
snippet: NexBridge is hiring a backend platform engineer to build API services, data workflows, and internal tools for hiring products.
content: Backend platform engineer role focused on Python, API design, SQL, cloud deployment, and collaboration with product and operations teams. Candidates should show project ownership, communication, and service improvement experience.

title: NexBridge Company Overview
snippet: NexBridge builds hiring workflow software for teams that need better recruiting operations and candidate communication.
content: NexBridge is a software company focused on recruiting workflows, candidate communication, and analytics. The company emphasizes structured execution, cross-functional teamwork, and measurable product outcomes.

title: RiverLoop Careers - Product Operations Analyst
snippet: RiverLoop is hiring a product operations analyst to support metrics reporting, issue tracking, and process improvement.
content: Product operations analyst role with responsibilities across reporting, issue triage, stakeholder communication, and process documentation. Candidates should be comfortable with spreadsheets, dashboards, and operational follow-through.

title: RiverLoop Team and Culture
snippet: RiverLoop highlights experimentation, cross-team communication, and practical customer problem solving.
content: RiverLoop describes a collaborative environment with strong emphasis on clear ownership, customer context, and operational consistency.
